name: LangGraph
use_case: Canonical agent orchestration. All agents run on LangGraph. Climate Risk Agent is v1.0 canonical template.
notes: Freeze Climate Risk Agent as v1.0. All new agents must mirror exactly.

name: Google/LF A2A Protocol v0.3
use_case: Inter-boundary agent collaboration. SeaBridgeAI A2A portal built on this. 6 core services pending.
notes: Core infrastructure. Blocking A2A portal launch.

name: FastMCP
use_case: SSE server at network edge. Replaces stdio for all network-boundary MCP calls.
notes: Required. stdio never crosses network boundary - FastMCP SSE handles all edges.

name: Cecil SDK (Wagner)
use_case: Geospatial physical risk scoring. Climate Risk + Nature Risk agents.

name: ENCORE/NCFA Dataset
use_case: Nature dependency + impact mapping. TNFD LEAP UNEP FI co-development requirement.
notes: UNEP FI co-dev requires this. Already integrated.

name: Nominatim Geocoding
use_case: AOI polygon geocoding for Nature Risk TNFD LEAP Locate step. MongoDB caching required.
blocker: Rate limiting without self-hosting. MongoDB AOI cache not built yet.
notes: Build MongoDB caching layer before production.

name: WRI Aqueduct
use_case: Water stress risk layer in Climate Risk agent.
notes: Integrated. Physical risk scoring across all asset classes.

name: CLI-Anything (HKUDS)
use_case: Wraps any CLI tool as an MCP server. Useful for ENCORE CLI without rewriting.
notes: Evaluate for wrapping ENCORE/NCFA CLI tools.

name: Tavily Research API
use_case: Agentic research loops inside Climate Risk + Nature Risk agents.

name: Swarms (kyegomez)
use_case: Parallel multi-agent for portfolio-scale scans. No MCP support.
blocker: No MCP support. Diverges from LangGraph canonical template.
notes: Watch only. Do not adopt until MCP support ships.
